verdict.rationale: MoonPay's developer docs describe an official MCP server for AI agents, and a probe confirms the using-agents page exists. However, that server only lets agents search and retrieve documentation content; nothing shows it exposes MoonPay's product capabilities such as quotes, transactions or account operations. Missing for 10: an MCP server exposing MoonPay platform/API actions (not just docs search), setup/auth details for connecting agents, independent or hands-on corroboration.
